title: Marking a line writes a note with its price, cost and hours
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with its own labor rate of $120.00 an hour and one asset, asset 1.
  • Have a new invoiced work order for this test, work order 2, for customer A on asset 1.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Approved, billable, on asset 1, with line 2 of 1.5 hours and one stock part costing $40.00, priced $180.00 for labor only.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open line 2's three-dots menu.
  3. Click "Mark as No Charge".
  4. Pick "Comeback" in Category.
  5. Pick work order 2 in "Original work order".
  6. Pick its first line in "Original line".
  7. Click the confirming Mark as No Charge button.
  8. Open the Notes tab.
  9. Open the work order's Audit Log.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The menu shows "Mark as No Charge".

Step 3:

  • The dialog opens.

Step 4:

  • The original selects appear.

Step 5:

  • Work order 2 is picked.

Step 6:

  • The line is picked.

Step 7:

  • Line 2 shows "No Charge · Comeback".

Step 8:

  • A system note by ShopView reads "Line '[line 2's title]' marked No Charge by [user]. Category Comeback, original work order [work order 2's number], original line [its line number]. Line price $180.00 removed; cost $40.00 and 1.5 h kept. The work order stays billable."

Step 9:

  • The Audit Log has a row for the mark with the user and the time.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as the work order's number or the customer's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close), story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S12-R6: “Each action writes a system note on the work order and an Audit Log row (S2-R18): "Line '[title]' marked No Charge by [user]. Category [name], original work order [number], original line [number]. Line price $[price] removed; cost $[cost] and [hours] h kept. The work order stays billable."; "Category of line '[title]' changed from [a] to [b] by [user]."; "Line '[title]' marked Billable by [user]. Priced as a new line would be today: $[price]. Category [name] removed."”
  • S2-R18: “Every classification change writes a read-only system note on the work order (Notes tab, author ShopView, with the user and the time) and an Audit Log row: Convert to No Charge ("Converted to No Charge by [user]. Category [name], original work order [number]. Prices, fees and discounts removed; costs and hours kept."), Change category (from, to, original work order kept or cleared), Convert to Billable ("Every line priced as a new line would be today. Category [name] removed."), Close (posting date, account), Reopen, and the line actions of Story 12 (S12-R6). Work order numbers in notes are links.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Line marked, category changed, line made billable | The three notes of S12-R6 | System note on the work order and Audit Log row”
